title: Chapter 669
paragraphs: Chapter 669
Episode 170. Another Friend, Meeting Dante (2)
"A subspace within a sword…?"
"First, I need to explain why Nero and I could enter the fifth tomb."
Valeria wasn't a contractor of Soldelet, couldn't control chaos like Heluram's daughter, and hadn't been guided by someone like in the Wantar Forest.
She didn't forcefully destroy it like Zipil or other forces, so she should not have been able to enter the tomb.

"You said you were tired from the spirit energy, Valeria. You also mentioned that thanks to obtaining an artifact related to the old Rune Candle from the cat god's temple with the help of the Mioin tribe."
"Did I tell you what that artifact was?"
"You said it was a handkerchief."
A handkerchief.
It might be a trivial thing, but it contained many stories from a thousand years ago.

"Yes, it was a handkerchief owned by the old Rune Candle's ten knights. That's why the tomb responded to the handkerchief and opened the door without a spirit or a guide. The records and stories left on the handkerchief served as the key."
However, that was a one-time measure.
The stories contained in the handkerchief were too distant and faint, Valeria had planned to preserve it well and analyze it after advancing her record magic.
But the handkerchief disappeared immediately when the door opened, and Valeria still regretted it.
"Then... The Prophet might have opened the door in the same way."

"That's likely. He must have opened it at least twice. He had overlaid the fate of Padler Rune Candle, who was originally the tomb's guardian, onto your second sister. Anyway, I discovered how to enter the next tomb in there before your sister replaced Padler."
Unlike the other tombs experienced so far, there was a clue leading straight to the next in the fifth tomb.

"In the fifth tomb, not only the record of Padler Rune Candle was left, but also the record of a person named Veil, the owner of the handkerchief. That was also why the tomb responded to the handkerchief."
"Veil...?"

"However, Veil's record was too faint, I could only confirm that the sixth tomb was hidden in his sword, and the rough location where the sword was initially hidden. It's in the Black Sea, but the chance of it still being there isn't very high..."
At that point, Jin felt like he was hit hard in the back of the head.
"Wait a moment, Valeria."
"Why?"

"The handkerchief you got responded to the fifth tomb because it belonged to Veil... The sixth tomb is a subspace existing inside Veil's sword, and the sword was hidden in the Black Sea... Is that what you're saying? You definitely said it was Veil?"
"Yes."
Jin blinked his eyes for a few seconds, and Valeria shrugged and looked around. The colleagues also seemed clueless.
"That sword, it seems we've already found it."
"What?"
-Hedo! Your sword! The sword is glowing and creating something, the sky is responding to our prayer!
-I'm seeing it too, miss. What the hell is this...
-It seems that the sword is the key to open the tomb. Where did you get the sword?
-I obtained it by slaying a monster in the Black Sea during my youth.
The conversation shared with Sandra and Hedo in the Coldran snowfields.
At the time, Jin breathed spiritual energy into Hedo's sword and naturally noticed the word 'Veil' written on the blade.
Since Hedo, the current owner of the sword, thought that was the name of the sword, Jin had believed the same.
But it turned out to be the name of one of the ten knights of the old Runcandel.
Now, he thought he understood why Murakan suffered when he saw Veil in the Sota desert, and why Veil could serve as the key to the fifth tomb.
"I think I didn't tell you how I entered the tomb because of the urgency. That sword is currently held by the keeper of the White Night Tower, Hedo."
"I had no idea you were so lucky, although the rescue process was much more reckless than I expected."
"Things related to you tend to be quite lucky. You also said it yourself before. There aren't many people as lucky as me."
For some reason, such an exclamation burst out simultaneously among the companions. Despite this, Jin and Valeria nonchalantly continued their conversation.
"I was going to rest for a few hours and then set off for the Black Sea, but it seems I've saved some trouble. I know Sandra Zifl and Hedo are quite friendly towards you."
"It's probably just Sandra Zifl, Miss Valeria. But that muscular butler always absolutely obeys Sandra Zifl, so we just need to call Sandra to check the sword."
"Mister Jet is talking as if you're some kind of trash who uses someone else's connections."
"Eeei? Miss Valeria, you can't twist the words of this good person like that! Our lord is not that kind of person!"

"We can't call Hedo and Sandra right now. We've recently made a lot of demands on Zifl, so we should wait a few days and then contact them. During that time, it would be perfect to go to Sword Emperor Castle."
"Heh, if the lord says so, I feel a bit embarrassed..."
"Our dear Jin, you look cool even when you're bad..."
"Jet, Enya. I'm not just trying to call them to use them for the sword. No matter how you look at it, it would be good to make those two our people. If possible."
He had seen what happened to Veradini.
Jin was sure that if Sandra continued to stay with Zifl, she would end up the same way in the near future.
He wanted to erase the name 'Zifl' from her.
Valeria found it uncomfortable to hear Jin's words about making 'Zifl' a comrade and expressed her opinion in a calm tone.
"Do as you wish. But never forget that someday, all Zifls in the world will surely die by my hand."
Valeria stands up from her seat.

"I should go rest a bit more. Mr. Kwall, let's resume the research in the evening. There are many documents that Jin brought from Lafrarosa, and the Red Owl mentioned there was a singularity connected to that world, so it looks like we will be busy again."
"Heh, Miss Valeria doesn't get tired. You said you saved some trouble because you didn't have to go to the Black Sea, but you're going straight back to work."
It's not that she doesn't get tired, it's that she can't afford to be. The grudges of her crushed and extinct clan and her murdered family members are all deeply ingrained within her.
Jin didn't say these words out loud.
"Then, I should get ready to go to the Sword Emperor Castle."
As soon as Jin left the meeting room, his companions naturally stared at the door where they had disappeared.
"They seem to have some similar aspects, those two."
"I think so too, old man Balkas."
"The lord gives a more human-like impression. Well, they both seem like people who have learned under a long-time teacher or parent."
"So, I'm considering creating a Valeria fan club. Like a side job?"
"You're kind of scary when it comes to this, Enya."
"Me!? Being told that by you, Faye!?"
"Come on, let's get to work. Jet, start investigating Ailan Bement, and Mary Kenge and Heiton, Daytona Kenge, uh..."
"You can speak comfortably, King Kashimir."
"Yeah, speak comfortably, king!"
"Hey, you guys, what's with that manner of speaking to a king? Are you going to lose your knightly dignity just because we lost the Garden of Swords? Do I have to take on the role of Mu An instead?"
"No, sir. We will correct ourselves."
"We have decided to become new people, sir."
"Keep that in mind. Go tell Cosmos to repair the ship. We're going to launch in a few days. Also, bring the list of knights who have recovered."
"Yes, sir!"
April 1, 1803.
"Oooooh!"
"Waaaaaaah!"

Two kids, their hair and eyes dyed black with Goldtail cosmetics and disguises, were continually exclaiming in amazement. In truth, one of them was a dragon that had lived for hundreds of years, but to all appearances, he was a little kid excited about a trip.
Latree and Yuria.
Jin decided to bring these two on the trip to Sword Emperor Castle. In case of emergency, Quicantel also followed as a guardian.

Not only the kids (one was a kid by dragon standards), but everyone also disguised themselves for the first time in a while. Jin and Quicantel had dark blue hair and were supposed to be dragon siblings.
"Jin oppa, Mr. Quicantel! The Red Owl is amazing. It really brought us to the Empire in an instant, just like a portal, right?"
"It's a good thing that there are things that seem miraculous even to the contractor of Azmil."
"What surprises me more is that Mr. Quicantel chose the arrival coordinates here. This log house... brings back so many memories."
A serene log house situated in the middle of a forest on the outskirts of the Bement capital.
This place was where Jin started changing the fate of Yuria and Enya in his early days as a prospective knight.
The very house with the same structure as the one where Murakan and Quicantel used to live together in the distant past.
Yuria had only heard about this place in stories.
That was because she had rarely been outside of the Tikhan. From the time she first met Jin to now, her uniqueness as a contractor of Azmil required extreme caution in all aspects of her life.
"Memories? Hmm... I do see some heavy emotions of regret and remorse scattered throughout this log house."
"Yuria, let's stop that talk and go eat some seafood soup you like before we go to the Sword Emperor Castle."
"Great, Mr. Quicantel! Jin oppa, just seafood soup? Can't we play until evening after eating?"
Yuria's naive appearance was both cute and pitiful.
"Yuria, you're the only princess of the Free State of Tikhan in the Barmel Alliance."
"Suddenly?"
"It means that if you have fun, the top person of the Empire will come to see you."
From that point on, the group really spent a lot of money and had a great time in the bustling Bement streets.
Although the world was grim due to the remnants of Gliac and Rosa, the capital of Bement was still as lively as before the times changed.
It was proof that Dante was governing well.
Jin looked at the peace of the land that his friend had painstakingly protected and nurtured with a proud heart.
And in the evening, when the second seafood soup was just served at another new seafood restaurant, there was no one left in the restaurant except them. Even the employees and the owner had left.
"Just as you said, Jin oppa, Lord Dante has arrived, hasn't he?"
Yuria spoke as she looked at Dante, who had just entered through the door.
Jin and Dante looked at each other and smiled silently for a while.
It was a reunion after about three years.
"How did you know and find this place, Dante?"
"I rushed over as soon as I heard a report that an artisan named Paul Gray Mick and his companions were indiscriminately spending cheques throughout the capital."
Jin gave a sly smile.
"Sit down, Dante. The food has just arrived."
